// sharedGlobals: Files outside every project whose change has to invalidate everything. An empty `sharedGlobals` would mean that bumping Angular in package.json, or changing paths in tsconfig.base.json, starts NOT ONE task — a pipeline green without having checked anything. Note: values in `namedInputs` must be arrays, so the comment cannot sit inside one.
// release: The release is driven by tools/release.mjs rather than `nx release` directly, because the build MUST come after the version bump. `preVersionCommand` runs before it, so the artifact would carry the old PCT_VERSION constant, and `manifestRootsToUpdate` would patch the manifest in dist alone — the package would agree with itself in one file and lie in the bundle.

release.// conventionalCommits: Section titles are English like the rest of the repository, and this file is read by consumers of the package. Hidden types do not disappear from history — only from the CHANGELOG.
release.// useCommitScope: Nx 23 reads a commit's scope as a project name by default, and counts a scoped commit as a patch unless the scope IS the project — this repository's scopes name components and areas (`chips`, `core`, `a11y`), never `components`, so with the default every scoped commit was a patch and the sixteen breaking ones were nothing: the rehearsal resolved 0.0.1 to 0.0.2 with `--first-release` (measured 2026-09-17, decision 0079). Off, every commit whose files touch the project counts, breaking included.

version.// adjustSemverBumpsForZeroMajorVersion: Before 1.0 a breaking change bumps the minor, not the major. Otherwise the first `feat(api)!` would throw the library straight to 1.0.0 and take away the unstable API that `req-project-latest` assumes outright.

changelog.// automaticFromRef: The first release has no previous tag to count the range from — without this `nx release` would have nowhere to take the history from.
changelog.// workspaceChangelog: There is exactly one publishable project, so a workspace changelog would be a second copy of the same content.
changelog.// renderer: The first entry is a measurement, every later one the conventional list (decision 0079). The renderer reads `PCT_FIRST_RELEASE` from `tools/release.mjs`, which is the one caller.
